description.p: You are given two arrays nums1 and nums2, sorted in ascending order. Return a new array nums3 that contains all the common elements of nums1 and nums2.
The result must also be sorted in ascending order. If an element occurs several times in the arrays, it must be duplicated in the answer.

ul: Time: O(n+m), where n is the size of the array nums1, m is the size of the array nums2
Space: O(min(n,m)), where n is the size of the array nums1, m is the size of the array nums2
